info.title: Udyam Digital API
info.description: Digital MSME acquisition & onboarding prototype (Airtel SYNC 2026, Track A). Synthetic data only; registry adapters are mocks.

get.description: Business types the advisor understands (same registry as the chat extractor), for the form fallback.
Pre-fill helper. Returns only what onboarding needs (data minimisation) and is rate limited.

patch.description: Form-based alternative to chat: validated partial update, then recommendation if complete.

post.description: Save a quote to come back to later (addresses 'decided to wait').
Move an order to its next milestone. Staff in any environment; customers only in demo mode.

get.description: Right to access: a summary of what we hold, with identifiers masked.

Show the full call-back number to the person making the call. Every reveal is audited.
